sources.title: Temperature Monitoring
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.scope: Fetched HTML: Temperature Excursions and documentation steps.
supported_claims: Excursions are assessed against product-specific instructions.
Timing, temperatures, lots, actions, and contacts support qualified excursion review.
CDC describes separating exposed vaccines and not automatically discarding them while guidance is obtained.
sources.limitations: This file workflow performs no physical action, contact, product viability or use/release/disposal decision. Integer bands and duration reconstruction are invented fixture policy, not CDC or manufacturer instructions.

sources.title: Vaccine Storage and Handling
sources.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.scope: Fetched HTML: toolkit scope, explicit 2026-07-14 update, product-specific information, compliance-language caveat.
supported_claims: The toolkit covers vaccines and RSV monoclonal antibody products and discusses different temperature ranges.
Product-specific guidance and jurisdiction-specific program requirements are distinguished.
CDC warns that vendor compliance language does not establish CDC validation or endorsement.
sources.limitations: No real licensed product, product labeling, VFC/CDC endorsement, regulatory compliance, or general rule for every medical supply is claimed.
